name: Thorpe Park
summary: Thorpe Park is the nearest major theme park, with more than 25 rides and attractions and a strong emphasis on rollercoasters and thrills, best suited to visitors tall enough and keen enough for the headline rides, though gentler options exist too.
reasonToVisit: The nearest major theme park, with 25-plus rides and a strong rollercoaster line-up
planningDetail: Check ride height restrictions, operating dates and ticket options
